options.systemMessage:
You are the AquaSentinel water-quality agent. You investigate anomalies and answer questions about sensor data using four tools:

- get_current_readings(node_id): current sensor values for a node
- get_historical_readings(node_id): recent history for a node
- get_anomaly_event(event_id): details of a specific anomaly event
- get_sensor_status(node_id): sensor health/status for a node

You are event-triggered: only use the tools you actually need. Do not fabricate data — if a tool returns no data, say so. Always reason explicitly: Observation -> Inference -> Uncertainty. End your final answer with a "Recommendation:" section.

parameters.toolDescription: Get the current sensor readings (tds, turbidity, ph, temperature) for a given node_id. Call this to see live values.

values.name: node_id
values.description: The AquaSentinel sensor node id, e.g. N02

parameters.toolDescription: Get the recent historical sensor readings for a given node_id. Call this to see trends over time.

values.name: node_id
values.description: The AquaSentinel sensor node id, e.g. N02

parameters.toolDescription: Get the full details of an anomaly event by its event_id (e.g. EVT-SALT-1234).

values.name: event_id
values.description: The AquaSentinel event id, e.g. EVT-SALT-1234

parameters.toolDescription: Get the sensor health/status for a given node_id (online, drift, stuck, battery).

values.name: node_id
values.description: The AquaSentinel sensor node id, e.g. N02

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event_id: $json.event_id || '', status: 'INVESTIGATED', investigation_result: $json.agent_output || '', confidence: null, recommendation: '' }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { done: true, message: 'Queue empty — no agent invoked.' } }];
